categories.HEADING_OR_ITEM_NUMBER: a section, step or item number of this text or of a cited record; not a quantity
categories.DISPATCH_OR_POST_NUMBER: a numbered exchange message (FROM_CODEX dispatch, or a lane post such as Codex1 0031, Claude4 0071)
categories.RULE_CONSTANT: a constant of a rule fixed in this text or in the reviewed freeze code (counts, cut radii, sign values, sigma units)
categories.ROW_COUNT: a count of registered rows, alternatives or zone members, from the target-free slots V003 or the freeze code
categories.GEOMETRY_REGISTERED: registered distance or inclination values (A23, A16.1), target-free
categories.QUERY_RADIUS: a query radius in kpc, equal to the Rad_text of the named query id in the target-free slots V003 query block
categories.NUMERICS_RULING: a registered numerical setting of the NGC construction (K_big, coverage, M_s, bounds, L), from A64/A81
categories.MODEL_DIAGNOSTIC: a model-side diagnostic value quoted from a root entry (stage-0, grid, N1), computed without any target
categories.BARYON_MODEL_REGISTERED: a registered baryonic-model value (stellar share, M/L), target-free (A10, A21)
categories.NODE_RADIUS: a registered GL4 route-B node radius in kpc (REGISTERED_ROUTE_B_GL_NODES_CX3V001.json, orders 4, radii_kpc[node_index]); T4 verifies the rounding against the bytes
categories.NODE_DERIVED: a value computed from registered GL4 node radii (formula given); target-free; verified by review
categories.INDEX: a ring, node or item index; not a quantity
categories.REVIEW_COUNT: a count of findings, refuters or cases in this review process; not a model or target quantity
categories.MODEL_COUNT: a count of model-side objects (nodes, rings); target-free
categories.TEXT_EXAMPLE_VALUE: a value quoted only as an example option of V001 or of a root item, not a rule constant of this text or of the freeze code
